dict.string: NotchFlow uses Apple Music to fetch animated artwork for the lock screen wallpaper.
NotchFlow uses audio capture to display the real-time music waveform visualizer.
NotchFlow uses the microphone only while you read a script in Cuely, so it can follow your place.
NotchFlow needs screen recording permission to capture screenshots for the AI assistant feature.
NotchFlow's Cuely recognizes your speech only while you read a script, to keep your place. Nothing is saved. If on-device recognition is unavailable, audio is sent to Apple's speech service.
